evaluation.scope: same development cases as seed419; comparable, NOT independent case confirmation

primary.unit: case ID clustered across all six cells and all four arms

scale_check: marginal failure OR T24/T12 and log OR_KDA-log OR_GRU; D>0 corresponds to log-failure-odds interaction<0

gate.REPLICATED_PRELIMINARY: D>0 and CI excludes0; KDA SR delta>0, GRU<0, both pass secondary correction; scales agree; prior seed419 same signs
gate.PARTIAL: D>0 and CI excludes0, but any full criterion fails, including missing within-arm significance

stage2: M1 and M2 require new user authorization even if replicated
M1_limits: History replacement creates distribution shift; value/ranking/action sensitivity alone is not memory causal value
M2_deferred: Only after authorized M1 localizes an effect; candidate explanations are not established defects
n_seeds_scope: n=2 checks sign replication only; do not estimate architecture-level seed variance

storage.backup: Immediately after all training and evaluation finish: rsync, both-side every-file SHA256, then weight-only deletion
storage.deletion_guard: Neither inventory empty; re-enumerate and hash remote list before deletion; no directory or non-weight deletion

other_line: Bayesian CA baseline not coupled to these overnight GPU runs; not launched by this controller
